taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: GraphQL subscription entitlement after connection setup
controls.source_trace: Trace authorization at subscribe time and each delivered event, including membership/session changes while the connection remains open.
controls.implementation_branch: Record whether the contract requires immediate per-event reauthorization or bounded revocation propagation. Events queued before revocation need issuance/delivery timing. A still-open WebSocket without protected events is not continued access; separately test reconnect under the revoked identity.
controls.controlled_verification: Subscribe with an owned account, revoke its synthetic resource entitlement, then emit one inert event; compare a still-entitled subscriber.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An open connection is not itself unauthorized data delivery; buffered already-authorized events require timing evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Revalidate or terminate according to policy and retest revocation, reconnect and entitled event delivery.
